title: 2019 HMMT February Guts Problem H_{1}
statement: Let \(r=H_{1}\) be the answer to this problem. Given that \(r\) is a nonzero real number, what is the value of \(r^{4}+4 r^{3}+6 r^{2}+4 r\) ?

solutions.text:
-1
Since \(H_{1}\) is the answer, we know \(r^{4}+4 r^{3}+6 r^{2}+4 r=r \Rightarrow(r+1)^{4}=r+1\). Either \(r+1=0\), or \((r+1)^{3}=1 \Rightarrow r=0\). Since \(r\) is nonzero, \(r=-1\).
